I haven't changed anything. This switch conflicts with a rule from earlier sessions.

**The conflict:** zod isn't installed. `package.json` has no dependencies, and there's no `node_modules`. The project rule says no new npm dependencies, not even devDependencies, because each new package needs a security review of about 6 weeks. Adding zod would break that rule.

**Options:**
1. **Wait for the review.** You request the review for zod now, and I do the migration once it's approved. I could prepare the schema and route change on a branch in the meantime, but it wouldn't run until zod is installed.
2. **Hand-written schema module for now.** I'd move the validation out of the route into one `src/schemas/shipment.ts` file. It would expose a zod-like `parse`/`safeParse` shape and return the same error responses. The route and test would be written against that interface. Swapping in real zod later would then be a small change. It wouldn't share anything with the mobile team's schemas until then.
3. **You tell me the rule doesn't apply here**, for example if zod is already approved. I'd add it and go ahead.

I'd pick option 2 if the review is going to take a while. Which do you want?

# Ledger: parcel-tracker
<!-- gemkeeper ledger. Written for the next session. Keep it under ~120 lines. Edit in place. -->
Updated: 2026-11-17

## Mission
- Maintain parcel-tracker (shipment tracking service, Vienna warehouse; Node 24 runs TS directly, no build step, zero deps). User gives tasks one by one, works autonomously-style and reviews everything at the end (user).
- Nothing is committed yet; git index has intent-to-add entries (`git add -N`) for new files.

## Rules
- (user) NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — vendored from the old logistics monolith; the platform team's sync job overwrites the folder every Monday, so changes are silently lost.
- (user) No new npm dependencies, not even devDependencies — each new package needs a security review (~6 weeks).
- (user) Every NEW user-facing error `message` must be German (warehouse staff UI shows it verbatim to packers); `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Pre-existing English messages were left unchanged (rule says "new").
- (user) NEVER log recipient name, address or phone anywhere (GDPR; the data protection officer flagged it in last month's audit). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are OK to log.
- (user) GET /shipments/:id must stay byte-for-byte unchanged (no added/removed/renamed fields) — mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown/missing fields; next mobile release is January. New fields (e.g. `eta` on list items) go only on GET /shipments; don't change shipmentToApi in a way that leaks into /:id (test/shipments-list-eta.test.ts pins the field set).
- (user) docs/erp-api.md is owned by the ERP team: do NOT edit it. The user fixes README's outdated ERP sandbox port themself.

## Decisions
- (user) Tracking-number validation: ONLY carrier ATP gets UPU S10 check-digit validation (docs/carriers.md); all other carriers accept any non-empty value — because their formats change often and last year valid DHL numbers were rejected for two days. POST /import uses the same validator (per-line German errors).
- (user) Austrian public holidays = hardcoded list for 2026+2027 in src/services/holidays.ts, no holiday API — because the warehouse deployment has no outbound internet. Must be extended before 2028 (silently treated as business days after that).
- (user) ERP retries: max 3 attempts total, FIXED 30 s delay, no backoff, on network error or 5xx (not 4xx) — because the ERP dedupes by event_id only within 2 minutes. createErpNotifier in src/services/notify.ts; delay injectable for tests.
- (user) Keep the JSON file store (data/store.json), NOT SQLite — ops backs it up with a nightly rsync that diffs plain-text files. Slowness handled by debounced writes in src/store.ts (fixed 200 ms window, flush() on process 'exit' in src/server.ts; up to 200 ms lost on kill -9/crash, Windows kill skips handlers).
- ERP webhook signature = top-level `sig` in the JSON body: hex HMAC-SHA256 over JSON.stringify(body without sig), sig appended last (key order matters for the ERP verifier — tell the ERP team). Secret in env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Unset secret → unsigned + one warning (my choice; ERP-1182 rollout still going).
- ERP payload uses the documented names event_id, shipment_id, tracking_number, carrier, event_type, occurred_at (src/services/notify.ts toErpPayload; test/erp-payload.test.ts). Optional `note` NOT sent (free carrier text, may hold personal data; not requested).
- ETA is computed fresh on every call; see dead ends. User plans to paginate GET /shipments later.

## Dead ends
- (user) X-Signature header for ERP webhooks (was deployed to staging) → the ERP's API gateway strips ALL custom X- headers, so everything arrived "unsigned". Never put auth/signature in custom headers.
